_comment: Face landmark zones on the locked base, 1024-space (halve for viewBox units). `placement` is the MEDIAN across the generated avatar set — where a feature is drawn. `observed` is the envelope, i.e. the full range seen; it is informational. Checks use `placement`: the envelope's corners fall on the temples, where hair legitimately sits, so checking against it fails styles that are perfectly fine.

mouth._extract_note: The band used for EXTRACTION, in 1024-space — not a measurement. `placement` is only 28px tall (the median of the closed LINE mouths) and `observed` was measured before any open mouth existed; the laugh's tooth band centred 7 units above the `observed` ceiling and was silently dropped. This band runs from just below the nose (bottom y565) to the chin (y759) with slack, which is where a mouth can anatomically be.
